resumeText:
Karthika Ramesh | Coimbatore | karthika.r@example.com | github.com/karthika-dev

EDUCATION
B.E. Computer Science and Engineering, PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore, 2026 | CGPA 8.6/10

INTERNSHIPS
Flutter Developer Intern, Kovai Apps Studio, Coimbatore | Jan 2026 - Mar 2026 (12 weeks)
- Built the order history and profile screens of a grocery delivery app in Flutter.
- Called the shop's REST APIs with the http package and showed cached orders when the phone was offline.
- Moved the cart state from setState to Provider so three screens share one cart.
- Raised every change as a Git pull request and fixed review comments from the senior developer.

Web Intern, Thinkgrid Solutions, Remote | June 2025 - July 2025 (6 weeks)
- Fixed layout bugs on a company website built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

PROJECTS
- CampusEats: A Flutter app for ordering from the college canteen with Firebase login; published the app on the Google Play Store with 300+ installs.
- Expense Splitter: A Flutter app using Bloc to split trip expenses among friends.
- Weather Now: A small React Native app built while following an online course.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Mobile Application Development, Software Engineering, DBMS, Computer Networks
- Flutter and Dart: The Complete Guide (Udemy), 2025

SKILLS
Flutter, Dart, Provider, Bloc, Firebase, REST APIs, Git, flutter_test, Android Studio, Java (basic)

ACTIVITIES
- Lead, Google Developer Student Club mobile track, 2025-26.
- Ran a Flutter workshop for 80 second-year students.
